title: Custom Island Tour - for 4 to 5 people - up to 8 hours - Private tour of Oahu
includes: Car seats or booster seats for children
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We provide Private, Custom, tours of the island of Oahu. You can set the itinerary or leave it up to our expert guides, or a mix of both. We've been giving tours since 2012. Check out our TripAdvisor reviews to see what people enjoyed doing. We pick you up right from your hotel, at 8:30am. Look for a tour van with white letters on the side that says CustomIslandTours.com Please contact us if you would like a different start time. 
Note that the Honolulu City Council has banned All tour companies from certain beaches, which affects their ability to do snorkeling from the beach.
